overlap.method: Pairwise bbox relation is computed on source bboxes normalized to JGD2011 longitude,latitude. Disjoint-bbox minimum separation is approximated by comparing projected EPSG:6677 boundary segments sampled at 32 segments per edge. Projected axis-aligned envelopes are retained as context only.
overlap.interpretation_limit: BBox overlap only. It does not establish that features coincide, share a floor, or connect; it is not routing evidence.
